name: final-supervised-anchored-PPO-single-configuration
initial_model: model/V13.pt on geometric branch; original 26181-param actor
time_discount: gamma and lambda raised to actual physics step duration/(1/60); actual observation callback_dt computed by original builder
anchor: frozen own geometric V13, reference KL on full actual state sequences plus 4 independently labeled ground sequences each epoch; no external teachers
actor_optimizer: Fresh constrained-PPO Adam once at supervised-to-RL transition; preserve supervised optimizer unchanged; no repeated resets
critic: fresh separate training-only 13->64->64->1 critic, normalized return-loss scale, four warm-fit epochs on first on-policy batch before actor updates
forecast_columns: existing encoder columns [3,4,5,9,10,11] remain exactly zero; unchanged 13D runtime delivery
scenarios: 8/16 full normal match starts, 3/16 attack starts, 3/16 defence starts, 1/16 all-five kickoff, 1/16 varied ground; each goal resets kickoff while preserving both hidden states
opponent_pool: untouched V13, validated scratch-A, geometric candidate; uniform seeded sampling; frozen assets and hashes
reward: goals +10/-10; potential-based signed distance-to-goals and light car-ball-distance shaping; small productive contact velocity-change reward with cooldown; tiny nonproductive contact and sustained stationary costs; no raw touch-count reward
extension_rule: No further training if ground contacts <9/12, repeated Neutral collapse, or candidate loses more completed head-to-head matches than it wins vs geometric. Extend only if conservative head-to-head score >.5 with at least 5 completed wins, or credible matched improvement against baseline; otherwise stop initial stage.
promotion: Credible unused-seed paired match evidence, original validator and actual Windows RLBot acceptance required. Main remains untouched without native acceptance.
